# id: PG-pg-86-balance-swimming
# covers: PG 194 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 7D80DBB3+ (D7A60E49 ok), harness 33087EDE+ (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: findwater (radius 3000, depth 1.5) gives the nearest deep water and its longest straight run;
#   Avarek is teleported there per point and swims 30 m along that run (swimtime).
#   Result = swim_speed (distance in deep water / seconds in deep water).
# verify: findwater finds water with best_run >= 30 (else: this fixture has no water within 3 km: tell the
#   PG agent which save has some); deep_fraction near 1; own50 > none = swimming reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Avarek
@set WX findwater Avarek radius 3000 depth 1.5 ~ water at ([-\d.]+ [-\d.]+ [-\d.]+)
@set WD findwater Avarek radius 3000 depth 1.5 ~ best=(\S+)
findwater Avarek radius 3000 depth 1.5 ~ best_run=([3-9]\d|[1-9]\d\d)
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek ${WX}
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 ${WD} ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,10,0,none,w1,swim,0,${T},-
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek ${WX}
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 ${WD} ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,90,0,none,w2,swim,0,${T},-
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w3: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek ${WX}
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 ${WD} ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,50,0,none,w3,swim,0,${T},-
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w4: skill 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek swimming 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" swimming 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek swimming ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
teleport Avarek ${WX}
speed 1
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set T swimtime Avarek 30 ${WD} ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming,50,25,own25,w4,swim,0,${T},-
hunger Avarek 280
